holdout.todo: ./lab review holdout, then ./lab score holdout. Read each error.
holdout.done: You've read the errors. Then: ./lab next

gate.done: ./lab test-gate passes, and you've read human-review-queue.md after ./lab pipeline. That's the end of Part 2.
